subject: Evaluation kickoff & prompt prep — next steps from discovery
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@oliveai.com>, Tom Harris <tom.harris@cardinalhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Evaluation kickoff & prompt prep — next steps from discovery

Hi Marta / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and suggested next steps so we can get the evaluation (trial) started: 

1) Goal: Validate Redwood inference on your readmission-prediction pipeline with a 2-week trial. Success criteria you mentioned: throughput to support 500 concurrent inference calls, <=250ms 95th pct latency, and parity on AUC with your current model (within 1.5 points).

2) Kickoff: propose an evaluation kickoff (technical deep dive + trial plan sync) so our SE can capture your prompt set, data shape, and run the first ingestion.

3) Prep items we’ll share / need from you before the kickoff:
   - Redwood trial plan (attached) — outlines timeline, success criteria, and test harness.
   - Prompt template (attached) — please fill with 10 representative prompts/examples you want evaluated.
   - Technical contact for data ingestion and network/VPC questions (we’ll need an IP allowlist or VPC peering details if you want private deployment).

Proposed kickoff windows (PT):
   • Tue Sep 1 — 10:00–11:00 or 15:00–16:00
   • Wed Sep 2 — 09:00–10:00

Please reply with the best slot and the name/email of the technical stakeholder to invite. If none of those work, suggest two alternate windows and we’ll adapt.

I’ve looped in Ben (SE lead) to join the kickoff and Mateo (solutions engineer) will handle the technical runbook during the deep dive.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: trial_plan_v1.pdf, prompt_template.xlsx

From: Marta Ruiz <marta@oliveai.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Harris <tom.harris@cardinalhealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T12:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff & prompt prep — next steps from discovery

Thanks, Kimberly — great recap.

We’re aligned on the success criteria you listed; I added two items we’ll watch: model stability under burst traffic and token-level cost reporting for our finance partner.

For availability, Wed Sep 2 09:00 PT works best for both Tom and me.

Technical lead: Tom Harris (tom.harris@cardinalhealth.com) — he’ll confirm any network/VPC specifics.

I’ll start filling the prompt template and send an initial 10-example set by EOD Monday.

Quick question: do you need sample payloads (JSON schema) ahead of the call or is the prompt template sufficient?

—Marta
Marta Ruiz
Head of Integrations | OliveAI
marta@oliveai.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@oliveai.com>, Tom Harris <tom.harris@cardinalhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff & prompt prep — next steps from discovery

Perfect — Wed Sep 2, 09:00 PT is on our side. I’ve sent a calendar invite (link below) — please accept when you have a moment.

To Marta’s question: the prompt template is fine as a starting point, but if you can also drop a single sample payload (JSON with field names) into the shared folder that’ll speed up our ingestion test during the kickoff. I added a short checklist in the trial_plan_v1.pdf for data requirements.

Action items before the kickoff (who/when):
  - Marta: populate prompt_template.xlsx with 10 example prompts + accept calendar invite (Due: Mon Aug 31 EOD)
  - Tom: confirm network contact and whether you want private VPC or public-hosted trial (Due: Mon Aug 31)
  - Kimberly/Ben/Mateo: prepare runbook and quick sanity test harness; Mateo will lead the tech deep dive on Wed.

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=cardinal-eval-kickoff-20260831
Shared prompt template: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1PromptTemplate

Attachments included: trial_plan_v1.pdf (outline + test cases), prompt_template.xlsx (10-example template).

If you’d like, we can do a 15-minute pre-call on Tue to validate the sample payload; otherwise we’ll review on Wed during the kickoff.

Thanks — see you Wednesday.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: trial_plan_v1.pdf, prompt_template.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-08-30T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff & prompt prep — internal prep

Adding a quick internal note for runbook prep.

Mateo — I uploaded a lightweight customer prompt set for testing: customer_prompt_set.csv (10 rows) to our shared drive and linked it in the internal runbook folder. I’ll prepare a short checklist for the kickoff:
  - confirm sample payload schema exists and map fields to model inputs
  - pre-warm inference container with quantized weights for the initial test batch
  - instrument token-level cost logging + per-route latency traces

Kimberly — I’ll be on the Wed Sep 2 09:00 PT call and will own the quick ingestion test. Mateo, please validate the pre-warm config by Tue EOD so we have a clean run on Wed.

Ben Carter
